C2_tie_count_correction.why: pair(c,o) and pair(o,c) are mathematically identical but computed by two different arithmetic expressions, so a mutual-nearest pair can differ in the last bit and be counted as two distinct values. The C2_* fields above are affected; these are the corrected values, grouped with a 1e-12 tolerance.
does_not_affect: (ranks are unchanged: a last-bit split of an exact tie moves no class past another, it only splits a tie into two adjacent ranks)

H5_argmin_uniqueness_check.why: argmin is only well defined if the minimum is unique; where several opponents tie, the implementation keeps the alphabetically first, so H5 tested only one of them. This block recomputes H5 counting every tied opponent, and stores the full pair matrix.
